name: waykeep
description: Local-first shared memory for AI coding agents. Formerly cairn. This plugin wires the MCP tools (recall, learn, plan). For the full passive experience (briefings, pitfall warnings, auto-capture), install the runtime and wire hooks once: npm install -g waykeep (requires >= 6.0.0) && waykeep init — then run /hooks in Codex and trust the Waykeep entries.

interface.defaultPrompt: Recall relevant project memory with waykeep_recall before starting work, and store new lessons with waykeep_learn.
